'''Kin Kian''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] who served in [[Aggressor Wing|Aggressor Squadron]] and [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], he participated in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], serving as the [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] for [[Gray Leader/Legends|Gray Leader]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm's]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] as part of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] component that attacked the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]]. The battle ultimately ended with an Alliance victory, with Gray Leader surviving and the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] being destroyed.

==Biography==
===Alliance service and preparing for the Battle of Endor===
[[File:KinKianEntersBriefing-ROTJ.png|thumb|left|270px|Kin Kian (center) approaches his seat at the pre-Endor briefing.]]
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] Kin Kian<ref name="DSII-Kian" /> served as a [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="rotj" /> He was a part of [[Aggressor Wing|Aggressor Squadron]], although he left the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]]<ref name="DSII-Kian" /> by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. By that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|66|DET 1-2|Detailing the Rebel Assault}}</ref> Kian had also joined [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="DSII-Kian" />

In 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="FF" /> Kian was one of the Rebel pilots who attended a briefing aboard the [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 ''Home One'' type Star Cruiser]] [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']], where the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] discussed plans for destroying the Empire's [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. They planned for the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] to attack the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]], while a [[Endor strike team/Legends|strike team]] would travel to the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] to disable the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] protecting the [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] Death Star. In the subsequent [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm]] led [[Gray Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gray Squadron]], flying a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] with the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of [[Gray Leader/Legends|Gray Leader]].<ref name="rotj" /> Kian was also aboard Salm's [[Gray Squadron 1|Y-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] in the battle, where he was assigned as the [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]].<ref name="DSII-Kian" />

===Alliance victory===
{{Quote|All wings report in.|General Lando Calrissian, to Gray Leader and the other fighter wings|<ref name="rotj" />}}
As Gray Leader's gunner, Kian was present with other Alliance starfighters assembled in the [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]]. The [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]],<ref name="rotj" /> and Gray Leader was ordered to disable [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] between Calrissian and the Death Star.<ref name="DSII-Gray1">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Gray Squadron 1}}</ref> Gray Leader made the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace jump]] to the Endor [[Star system/Legends|system]], with Salm checking in after Calrissian requested all [[Fighter wing/Legends|fighter wings]] do so. Initially advancing toward the Death Star&mdash;anticipating that the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] was already down&mdash;Gray Leader and the other starfighters broke off from the attack just as the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] fleet appeared in [[Sector 47/Legends|Sector 47]] to counterattack the Alliance: the strike team had not yet deactivated the shield, and the Empire had planned a trap for the Alliance.<ref name="rotj" />

[[File:Colonel_salm.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Gray Leader, for whom Kin Kian served as a gunner]]
The strike team managed to disable the Death Star's deflector shield, prompting Gray Leader and other Alliance starfighters to follow Calrissian into the Death Star's superstructure to destroy the [[Space station/Legends|station's]] [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|reactor core]]. The Alliance fighters entered the superstructure through an access shaft, pursued by Imperial [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] and [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]]. Calrissian ordered several of the Alliance starfighters to head to the Death Star's surface to draw off some of the pursuing Imperial starfighters, with Gray Leader being among the starfighters to follow Calrissian's order. Calrissian managed to destroy the Death Star,<ref name="rotj" /> and Salm survived both the Battle of Endor and the subsequent four-[[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] fleet battle.<ref name="tabsb">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Kin Kian was light-skinned with [[Color/Legends|blond]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and dark [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="rotj" />

==Equipment==
Kin Kian wore an orange [[Rebel flight suit]] and a white [[Flight helmet/Legends|flight helmet]] with blue [[Alliance Starbird]] symbols.<ref name="rotj" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gray Leader's Y-wing starfighter first appeared&mdash;with Kin Kian as the gunner&mdash;in [[James Kahn]]'s [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ novel">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref> The novel was released [[May 12]], [[1983]],<ref name="YBY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> before the film was released [[May 25]] the same year.<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/critical-opinion-return-of-the-jedi-original-reviews|text=Critical Opinion: ''Return of the Jedi'' Original Reviews}}</ref> Kian's scenes were filmed throughout the week of [[February 16]], [[1982]] at Stage 5 of [[Elstree Studios]].<ref name="BTS">{{WebCite|url=https://swnz.co.nz/2017/03/11/gerald-home-tessek-squid-head-mon-calamari-officer-2|text=Gerald Home as Tessek (Squid Head) and Mon Calamari Officer|author=G., Matt|date=2004-06-11|work=[https://swnz.co.nz Star Wars New Zealand]|archivedate=20190724024037}}</ref>

In [[2000]], [[Decipher]] first named Kin Kian in the ''[[Death Star II Limited]]'' expansion for the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]]. In addition to naming Orris's extra on ''Home One'', the card game established he was Gray Leader's offscreen gunner during the Battle of Endor.<ref name="DSII-Kian" /> The character's name was previously used for [[Kin Kian (Sullustan)|Kin Kian]], a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] gunner for Aggressor Wing in the [[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 23|twenty-third]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series, which was released by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Empire's Service 3">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 23|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 23]]</ref> on [[October 1]], [[1997]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54668/star_wars_x-wing_rogue_squadron_1995_23|text=Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron (1995) #23}}</ref>
